title: Smoke Test — Manage-Order Payments Panel
subtitle: Phase 3: record offline payments + comp remainder against an order's ledger, with live balance reconciliation.

meta.Flow: login → event orders → open order → Payments panel → record payment → comp remainder
meta.Order: O-00H9VYK (id 133), set to AWAITING_OFFLINE_PAYMENT / total $1.57 for the test

steps.title: Orders list — order is awaiting offline payment
steps.description: Event 261 orders. Order O-00H9VYK shows $1.57 with payment status "Awaiting Payment" (offline). This is the order we will collect against.

steps.title: Payments panel — initial state (fully outstanding)
steps.description: Manage-Order drawer → Payments accordion. Balance summary shows Owed $1.57 and Outstanding $1.57 (red). The record form defaults the amount to the outstanding balance, and a "Comp remaining $1.57" action is offered for forgiving the balance.

steps.title: After recording a $1.00 partial cash payment
steps.description: Entered $1.00 cash, reference "check #4471", clicked Record payment. "Payment recorded" toast; Collected → $1.00, Outstanding → $0.57; a ledger row appears (Cash $1.00 · check #4471). Comp action updates to "Comp remaining $0.57". The order total/line items are never touched — this is a ledger credit against the receivable.

steps.title: After comping the remainder — order settled
steps.description: Clicked "Comp remaining $0.57". "Remaining balance comped"; balance shows Collected $1.00 + Comped $0.57 with a green Settled badge; ledger now has both rows (Cash $1.00, Comp $0.57). Order status reconciled to COMPLETED (the orders-list row also updated to "Completed"), and attendees activated — all derived from the ledger balance.
steps.notes: End-to-end round trip verified: form → POST /payments → RecordOrderPaymentService → ledger insert → ApplyOrderBalanceStatusService (status + attendee activation) → refetch → recomputed balance in the UI.
